verdicts.why: In All Roads Lead... Ruby, who locked Hale up in The Honeymoon, has Strucker run the infusion while Hale opposes it and orders it stopped on arrival; Hale's HYDRA does not do it.
Namor's warriors defeat Okoye and take Shuri and Riri underwater to Talokan; Nakia helps them escape. Shuri and Okoye do not bring her to Wakanda.
The Mark I survives the chase; after the Talokanil knock Riri out on the bridge, Namora and Attuma throw the armor into the water below, so it is lost, not wrecked by the chase.
Alexei finds and tries on the suit at Melina's homestead, is captured in it and taken to the Red Room, where he fights Taskmaster; he does not put it on for a planned raid.
At Camp Lehigh in 1970 it is Tony who meets and talks with his father Howard.
The 1945 SSR raid on Reinhardt's Austrian facility and his arrest are shown in Shadows (episode 23); The Things We Bury (30) shows his later interrogation and 1989 release.
The board agrees to merge the factions with Coulson remaining director in Scars, episode 42; episodes 43-44 are the Afterlife battle.
Cut off by Hayward, Monica gets a vehicle from S.W.O.R.D. personnel loyal to her mother rather than Hayward, then crosses the barrier herself and gains powers; she is not acting for S.W.O.R.D.
Goose's eggs hatch into kittens that Fury uses to swallow and evacuate the crew; Goose takes an escape pod to Earth and ends living at the Rambeau house with Carol, so Off-world is also wrong.
Fisk pays Turk to reveal to Vladimir that Fisk killed Anatoly in episode 5, World on Fire; episode 6 is his death.
Hoffman poisons Blake in hospital in episode 8, is knocked out by the masked man and claims the masked man killed Blake; he does not appear in episode 9, and his hiding under Owlsley comes later.
After stabbing Fisk in episode 2, Evans is put in solitary confinement at Rikers; he is freed only in episode 4, so In custody fits this record.
Lucian stabs Strange's physical body at the New York Sanctum; Christine operates on him at Metro-General while his astral form duels Lucian.

The 2012 Time Heist record is misplaced after Multiverse of Madness; the sibling stone files (Aether, Orb, Soul Stone) place this kind of record right after the Endgame destruction record, which move_after 5 matches.

Under the binding convention a multi-episode record carries its last episode: the Chafa talk (episode 2) and the new leg (episode 3) are both true and the last event is in episode 3, so nothing is wrong; the proposal only rewords.
Maw pins the Cloak in New York stoplights; it breaks loose there, flies after Strange into the ship and helps Tony and Peter rescue him. It does not slip free on the ship.
Nicepool accompanies the Deadpool Corps to Earth-10005, then retrieves Dogpool, who has run to Wade and Logan, and warns them; he does not follow Dogpool into Wade's world.
Wong is dropped to the ground; Strange alone kills Gargantos by spearing its eye with a light pole.
Sersi and Sprite already live together in London; Kro's attack reunites them only with Ikaris.
Nkati's pirate fleet raids Minoan Crete for captives; he rules his own kingdom (a fleet and deep-sea complex), not Crete.
After Tony's funeral Groot and the Guardians pick up Thor at New Asgard and leave Earth on the Benatar, so the title leaves him Off-world.
Sources describe the Uni-Mind turning Tiamut to stone as preventing his Emergence; that only his head and hand had risen is a nuance, not a clear error in the record.
Karja is fooled by the maintenance disguises; Kwol recognizes Drax and Mantis on the cameras and alerts him, and he then shoots Drax.
Stane paralyzes Raza with a sonic taser and has his group killed; Raza survives (fandom status Alive) and returns in VisionQuest episode 6, so Deceased and 'has him killed' are wrong.
Christine's only Iron Man 2 scenes are in Monaco, interviewing Hammer for Vanity Fair and leaving him to chase the story when Tony takes the race car; she is not shown at the Stark Expo.
